description: This file contains implementations related to distance calculations such as pairwise distance, Euclidean distance, and cosine similarity within the ATen/native directory of PyTorch. It defines functions and dispatchers for computing various types of distances and their backward passes, referencing external operator implementations and including core tensor operations.

methods.name: Tensor pairwise_distance(const Tensor & x1,const Tensor & x2,double p,double eps,bool keepdim)
methods.description: Computes the pairwise distance between two tensors with specified norm p, epsilon, and whether to keep dimension.

methods.name: Tensor pdist(const Tensor & self,const double p)
methods.description: Calculates the pairwise distance for each pair of rows in a 2D tensor.

methods.name: Tensor cdist(const Tensor & x1,const Tensor & x2,const double p,std::optional<int64_t> compute_mode)
methods.description: Computes the distance matrix between two batches of vectors, supporting different norms and optional modes.

methods.name: Tensor _cdist_forward(const Tensor & x1,const Tensor & x2,const double p,std::optional<int64_t> compute_mode)
methods.description: Internal function to compute the forward pass of cdist, assuming inputs are validated.

methods.name: Tensor _pdist_forward(const Tensor & self,const double p)
methods.description: Compute the precomputed distances between all pairs in a single 2D tensor.

methods.name: Tensor cosine_similarity(const Tensor & x1_,const Tensor & x2_,int64_t dim,double eps)
methods.description: Calculates the cosine similarity between two tensors along a specified dimension, with epsilon for numerical stability.
